description: Live DEX pool snapshot from DexScreener for one pool address on one chain (Uniswap, Raydium, Curve and other DEXes DexScreener indexes): USD liquidity, token reserves, price, 24h volume and transactions, FDV. Slippage is not computed. Data is DexScreener's aggregate, not raw on-chain reads. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

chain.description: DexScreener chain slug, e.g. ethereum, base, solana, bsc
